_comment: Parameters of the default tactic 叠层优先 (trait stacking). Edit <program folder>/tactics/default.json to override.
trait_weights: value of each stacking trait (精准 > 奥术 > 远见). composition: wanted field count per trait;
below the target a trait counts below_target_factor x weight, above it over_target_factor x weight; 远见 has no target and always counts fully.

medics / medic_count / medic_bonus: one medic wanted on the field. duplicate_bonus[n]: value when n copies are owned (3 merge into an elite); for 1-cost operators it is multiplied by cheap_merge_factor, and cost_bonus adds value by cost.

Shop levels: from upgrade_from_round the shop is levelled straight to buy_first_level. From that level on operators are bought first; the shop goes up one level when the field (distinct operators) reaches any lineup in level_up_lineups for the current level, or after level_up_after_rounds rounds of buying at that level.
tier_value: small tie-breaker by tier. min_field_by_round: operators wanted on the field from that round on, bought before shop upgrades.
bench_keep: when the bench (整备区, 10 slots) is full, sell down to this many. sell_trait_order / foresight_first_over: see the selling rules in README.
ranged: name fragments that take the wooden-frame (safe) cells first; medics and 精准 operators do too.
sell_for_funds_max / sell_for_funds_margin: sell up to this many bench operators (no duplicates) to afford a card worth at least the margin more than the best affordable one.
